name: SGLang-JAX (Tenstorrent backend)
description: The JAX backend of the SGLang serving engine, which now carries an upstream Tenstorrent hardware backend in `python/sgl_jax/srt/hardware_backend/tt`. The backend lowers paged attention and Qwen3.5 gated-delta-net recurrence to TTNN kernels through JAX `ffi_call`, using the `libtt` PJRT plugin as the device runtime, and supports DFlash speculative decoding. It is single-device today; the PRs report Qwen3-8B serving on a Blackhole P150 at TP1.
author: sgl-project
